breakingChangesNotes: Incidents are now fetched from the v4 incident inventory API, which returns a summary of each incident, so fetched incidents contain fewer attributes than in version 2.3.x. The *PAN DLP Tenant ID* and *File SHA256* incident fields are no longer populated. The *PAN DLP Previous Feedback* incident field now holds the feedback status of the fetched incident itself as an enum value, so the conditions that check it in the *DLP Incident Feedback Loop* and *DLP - Get User Feedback* playbooks no longer match. The *PAN DLP Incident Region* values *AP*, *PAR* and *SUI* are now *SG*, *FR* and *CH*. In the incident raw JSON, several keys were removed or changed format, and *incidentDetails* now contains only the severity header and the application name. Review any custom mappers, layouts and playbooks that use these fields. See the release notes for the full list.
